title: Flipbook Beat
generation_prompt: Original all-ages melodic-house instrumental for a one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 126 BPM in 4/4. From the FIRST SECOND through the final bar keep an audible quantized four-on-the-floor kick on EVERY quarter beat, dry short clap on beats two and four, separate closed eighth-note hats, and at least one exposed short pitched midrange pluck or muted-key attack between main beats in every bar including the middle. No fade-in, beatless intro, drum dropout, half-time break, tempo drift, ambient-only bridge or long reverb smear. Signature hook: two warm wooden-key notes hop upward, leave one crisp eighth-note rest, then three small glass-bell notes turn downward like a quick page flip; keep the call and response clearly separated. Rounded syncopated bass and brief bright major-seventh chord stabs support the groove without covering kick, clap or note starts. At the midpoint retain the SAME unbroken drum grid, let the glass answer appear first in a higher register and change the bass roots; the ending combines both figures in a new playful cadence rather than copying the opening. One evolving 128-second stereo instrumental, buoyant, friendly and cleanly separated, with no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Flipbook Beat, an all-ages melodic-house rhythm-game track. Dynamic high-contrast editorial comic-print collage on near-black ink. Main motif: one large UNBRANDED blank flipbook with EXACTLY THREE oversized warm-ivory pages visibly fanning upward and to the right from a short coral-red binding at lower left; each page has one electric-cyan thick pulse mark in a different position, so the three marks form a clear rising beat sequence across the turning pages. Use bold simplified page silhouettes, tactile paper-cut shadows, sparse halftone and one tiny yellow timing spark. Readable as a flipping sequence at 100px, with calm dark space in the lower fifth for a local title overlay. No writing, pictures or symbols on the pages except the three cyan pulse marks; no hands, people, city, road, window, computer screen, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Flipbook Beat square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve one unbranded blank flipbook with exactly three oversized warm-ivory pages fanning upward from a short coral binding and one thick electric-cyan pulse mark on each page in a rising sequence, near-black comic-print background and sparse halftone. Recompose the flipbook motif on the RIGHT two-thirds, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines there: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Flipbook Beat' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Make a purpose-built wide card, not a stretched square crop. No other text, letters, numbers, hands, people, logos, watermark or copied game art.
